steps.speaker: Clingy Black Goo
steps.content: Do you want to ruin this? Do you want me to wake up? It wasn't easy for us to return... It wasn't easy for us to attain this...

steps.speaker: Clingy Black Goo
steps.content: Who made you the judge of good and evil, of truth and falsehood... Who are you to decide where we should stay... You know nothing... Who do you think you are...

steps.speaker: Clingy Black Goo
steps.content: Get out get out get out... Get out!!!

Is this the will of the Sleepwalkers? Or is it an illusion created by Serpent? She's able to use Ambrosia to connect all the Sleepwalkers through their dreams. This woman is as powerful as she is crazy.

As you get pulled and tugged, a wave of intense, chaotic feelings flood your mind. The aftereffects of Marv's attack have greatly damaged your sanity, rendering you unable to resist. Amidst the dizziness, you remember what that woman said.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content:
O dreamless one... You've never tasted a sweet dream, so you assume that no one else wants it, either...
You only have reality in your grasp, so you assert that everyone needs reality...
Your consciousness gradually fades away. Your last thought is feeling thankful that you came here alone without Hella and Hecate...
The light suddenly shines bright. Serpent shields you, and the serpent shadow wriggles to disperse the black goo on your body. The shadows remain unscathed, but just slither away beneath the ground.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Oops, looks like they're being cranky for being woken up...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: The ones you're trying to "rescue" seem to like their dreams more than I do.

She teased you and tortured you. She unleashed the monster she raised to filter your consciousness, and let the black goo shake your will. You are thoroughly exhausted from all her tricks. But in the end, she came to protect you.
...The expression on her face now is full of pity. What exactly does she want from you?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...Stop grappling what's right or wrong with me. Reality isn't that important. It's not worth risking your life for.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You just haven't experienced it before... If you understand it, you wouldn't reject it... No one can reject it.
She stands up. A huge picture frame slowly appears on the empty stage. It's the same one you dove into to catch her. You reached the innermost depths of Serpent's realm through it.

Now, warm specks of light begin to shimmer in the pitch-black frame. Through it, you can see the world outside the dream, the center where the Sleepwalkers connect... The world made from dreams inside the picture.
Only from this side, you don't see any Sleepwalkers sleeping happily inside the frame. Instead, you see one joyous scene after another. Long-lost passions, faraway dreams, rekindled friendships...
There isn't a hint of gloom in the picture. All the people inside the picture are starry-eyed. They are all glowing.
Serpent stands in the center of the vast empty space, before the frame overflowing with others' happiness. Joyous light illuminates her face, tinging it with brilliant colors.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: There's too much suffering in this world. Happiness is the only miracle, the only ray of light.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Isn't it great? I can still bring happiness to others. Seeing them happy brings a little bit of warmth to my heart.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: This picture is my last joy. I hope you can join this picture too, or at least don't ruin it.
Under the ethereal light, tiny cracks form on her skin. Other voices start echoing faintly from the dark void behind her.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Laugh. If you don't laugh, how will you make us laugh...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Not enough, still not enough.... We want more... More thrills... More intensity...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Joy... Give me joy... I only want joy... I want all the happiness there is...

options: ...What is the price of such happiness?

steps.content: Serpent notices the creeping darkness and smiles contemptuously. She flicks away the darkness behind her and takes your hand.
The sly luster in her voice has been replaced by curt sincerity. And whether you like it or not, you don't have the strength to shake off her grasp.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Don't force everyone to go back to reality. Don't ruin these joyful scenes.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...If you can ensure not to harm those in the real world.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If you're so worried about them, why don't I bring them in here right now?

options: Did you ever consider they might not want to?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: That's because they haven't experienced the sweet dreams I can give them.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Can illusory dreams really satisfy everyone?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes. What Ambrosia brings to everyone is flawless joy. A true paradise.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Too bad you can't experience it. But that's okay. What Ambrosia can't give you, I will.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If you fear waking up to pain and suffering, I can give them never-ending dreams. If you worry about someone getting hurt in the real world, I can bring everyone here.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Stay here and embrace me. I will give you happiness here.
Serpent hugs you. Her body is thin and her skin is cold. She's like a lonely night traveler longing for warmth and light, or a Sleepwalker in the picture clinging onto an illusory dream.
Behind her, the dreamy picture is emitting warm light. It's the only light in the darkness. Even you can't look away.
But through the light, you don't see the fabricated joy. What you see are those who aren't here.
Nightingale must be anxiously coordinating things right now. Has she come to the scene?
The FAC and the 9th Agency must also be trying their hardest to curb the spread of Mania. Have they used up all their Hypercubes? Did their wounds heal?
Are Hella and Hecate still awake? Are they still looking for you? Is everyone still fighting? Is the battle intense?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know you well, so I have no right to negate your choice. Maybe one day I'll also be unable to bear the pain and seek the comfort of your sweet dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But stop allowing Ambrosia to contaminate and destroy the world on the other side. Don't make us stand against you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The real world is tough, but not everyone hates it as much as you do. Maybe there are still people who cherish it and want to return. Don't block their way...
